signature_pad v5.1.3
====================

Released: 2025-12-03
Source:   https://github.com/szimek/signature_pad/releases/tag/v5.1.3
Build:    dist/signature_pad.umd.min.js (UMD bundle, defines window.SignaturePad)
License:  MIT (see LICENSE)
Fetched:  2026-10-14 by Max (MBP-1014-BURN) from the npm tarball below
          (first fetch 2026-05-23 via cdn.jsdelivr.net took the ESM file)
SHA-256:  0d8abbc3ba7c963b80edca55d1aed04383b6194e9ab521ca977a832f9b0dc5c4
Bytes:    15929
Tarball:  registry.npmjs.org/signature_pad/-/signature_pad-5.1.3.tgz
          integrity sha512-zyxW5vuJVnQdGcU+kAj9FYl7WaAunY3kA5S7mPg0xJiujL9+sPAWfSQHS5tXaJXDUa4FuZeKhfdCDQ6K3wfkpQ== (verified 2026-10-14)

2026-10-14 (MBP-1014-BURN): the file fetched 2026-05-23 as signature_pad.min.js
is the ESM build (ends in `export{x as default}`), so a classic <script> threw
"Unexpected token 'export'", SignaturePad was undefined and house-rules.html
disabled Submit. house-rules.html now loads signature_pad.umd.min.js. The old
ESM file is kept in place, unused (SHA-256 38c67ba2...39429f, 14877 bytes).

Pinned for supply-chain hygiene per the usmcmin.com booking-site security
posture: third-party JS is NOT hot-linked from a CDN; it's vendored, version-
locked, and integrity-tracked here.

To upgrade
----------
1. Fetch the new dist/signature_pad.umd.min.js (NOT signature_pad.min.js,
   which is the ES module build) from a tagged release.
2. Verify the SHA against the GitHub release artifacts if available.
3. Replace signature_pad.umd.min.js + LICENSE in this directory.
4. Update the pin version, fetched date, and SHA-256 above.
5. Bump the cache-busting query string on the <script src> tag in
   /house-rules.html (e.g. ?v=5.1.3 → ?v=5.2.0).
